I swore an oath&hellip;to be a good ''soldier''&hellip;not a ''slave''.|Darth Vader and Shale, just prior to the latter's death by suicide|<ref name="Darth Vader and the Lost Command 5">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 5|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 5]]</ref>}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], forces of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], were '''ambushed''' on the [[Atoan crystal planet]], in the [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|Ghost Nebula]], by [[Atoan]] rebels. [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Saro]] and former [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Garoche Tarkin]] were eventually killed by Vader in an attempted [[Death/Legends|suicide]].
